import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

np.random.seed(42)
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)

metabolite_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('met_')]
results = []
for met in metabolite_cols:
    male = df.loc[df['sex'] == 'Male', met].dropna()
    female = df.loc[df['sex'] == 'Female', met].dropna()
    stat, p = stats.ttest_ind(male, female, equal_var=False)
    results.append({'metabolite': met, 't_stat': stat, 'p_value': p})

table = pd.crosstab(df['hypertension'], df['t2d'])
odds_ratio, p_value = stats.fisher_exact(table)
result = {
    'variable': 'hypertension',
    'odds_ratio': odds_ratio,
    'p_value': p_value
}

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
results_df['rank'] = results_df['p_value'].rank(method='first')
results_df['fdr'] = results_df['p_value'] * len(results_df) / results_df['rank']
results_df = results_df.sort_values('p_value')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
plot_df = results_df.head(20)
ax.barh(plot_df['metabolite'], -np.log10(plot_df['p_value']))
ax.set_xlabel('-log10(P value)')
ax.set_ylabel('Metabolite')
fig.tight_layout()

output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
results_df.to_csv(output_dir / 'metabolite_sex_difference.csv', index=False)
